mapper.select: SELECT TOTLE_TRADE_ID FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 WHERE PS = 'T03' AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL = 'N' OR IS_CANCEL IS NULL) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD T2 WHERE ACT_SETTE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{cdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO WHERE SETTLE_STATUS = '02' AND TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID )
